ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle, so this older model offers little appeal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for an older tablet, especially after adding an Echo Show for convenient Alexa access.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent 4K Max bundle already fills this need.

ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to control a lamp through my existing Echo devices; it adds a useful function to my setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could be useful for my TV equipment, but I have no immediate need for another cable or this length.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added a fourth-generation Echo Dot, so I would skip this older version.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a second-generation Echo Show 5 and recently bought its stand.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet with Alexa Hands-Free, 10.1" 1080p Full HD Display, 32 GB, Marine Blue (Previous Generation - 7th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A tablet is not a current need, and this older model does not give me a clear reason to add one.
ItemID: NA; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have an Amazon Tap and several Echo devices; I do not currently need another portable speaker.
